articles.title: An illustrative study
paragraphs: Biodiversity and ecosystem services support communities across a range of landscapes. We used remote sensing to examine habitat fragmentation and species richness in a clearly defined study area. The analysis compared observations from multiple locations and periods, using consistent methods to minimise differences in sampling conditions.

Species richness differed across the sampled locations. These observations describe the locations studied and do not establish that a single environmental factor caused every observed difference. The study illustrates why spatial resolution and soil moisture should be considered when interpreting observational evidence. Future work could assess whether these patterns apply outside the original sampling area.
